description: An alert for new procurements by object terms and state (UF). Use the account session or guest token. Channels: pull, signed webhook or email. On webhook and email, it also delivers new tenders outside PNCP that have not opened yet (TCE-RS LicitaCon and TCE-PE open data). Name, organization and email recipients are optional. Two modes. By `termos`: a space requires all groups; `|` accepts alternatives within a group. By `cnpj`: known activity families produce alerts, up to `max_familias`. Unmapped activities remain in the response without an alert. The cron checks every 30 minutes. Email requires an account session and `EMAIL_ALERTAS=1`. It uses explicit recipients or the verified account email.

destinatarios.description: Email recipients: `para`, `cc` and `bcc` arrays. Up to 10 distinct addresses in total. An empty `para` list uses the account email. PATCH replaces all three lists. BCC is hidden from other recipients.

destino.description: HTTPS webhook URL. Ignored for pull and email.

filtros.description: Extra filter: modalities, municipalities, exclusions, values, open proposals and CNAEs. PATCH replaces the whole filter; {} clears it.

organizacao_id.description: Organization from `GET /api/me/empresas`. Membership and MFA are checked. Null removes the label. This does not share alert ownership.

resultados.description: It starts when turned on, without past results. `abertas` does not apply to results.

termos.description: Object words, 3 to 200 letters; a space means all, | means any (uniforme|fardamento).

name: create_alert
